templates.name: Mon: Upper A — Heavy Press / Row (~55 min)
templates.notes:
Superset blocks are linked in your log—alternate the two moves back-to-back, then take the listed rest after the SECOND move. Rest timers are set to that post-pair rest.
Heavy compounds: 2–3 min rest. Isolation pairs: 60–90 sec.
Effort: leave 1–2 reps in reserve (RIR) on compounds; last set of isolations can go to 0–1 RIR.
Progression: double progression—when every set hits the TOP of the rep range at ≤2 RIR, add 2.5–5 lb (cables/machines: one pin) next session and build back up. Target weights are starting points from your log—adjust to hit the range.
Warm-up: 1–2 ramp-up sets on the first lift only.

SS A (90 sec after A2): incline DB press + DB lateral raise. Press first while fresh; laterals second so the press is not limited by side delts.
SS B (90 sec): chest-supported machine row + Kelso shrug. Row first; use straps on shrugs so grip does not cut the set short.
SS C (75 sec): neutral-grip pulldown + overhead DB triceps extension (long-head triceps get a stretched-position set).
SS D (75 sec): seated DB shoulder press + incline DB curl (stretch-position biceps).
Goal: upper chest, lat/back thickness, delts, arms. Total ~22 sets.

templates.name: Tue: Lower A — Hack Squat Focus (~40 min)
templates.notes:
Superset blocks are linked in your log—alternate the two moves back-to-back, then take the listed rest after the SECOND move. Rest timers are set to that post-pair rest.
Heavy compounds: 2–3 min rest. Isolation pairs: 60–90 sec.
Effort: leave 1–2 reps in reserve (RIR) on compounds; last set of isolations can go to 0–1 RIR.
Progression: double progression—when every set hits the TOP of the rep range at ≤2 RIR, add 2.5–5 lb (cables/machines: one pin) next session and build back up. Target weights are starting points from your log—adjust to hit the range.
Warm-up: 1–2 ramp-up sets on the first lift only.

Hack squat vs. barbell/Smith squat: for size, a hack squat or leg press is the better choice for you—stable, trains close to failure with low spinal/low-back fatigue (important with med school), and lets you pair calves right after. Smith squat is an OK swap.
SS A (2 min after A2): hack squat + standing calf raise (calves don't limit the squat).
SS B (75 sec): leg extension + seated leg curl—antagonists. Seated curl trains hamstrings in the lengthened position (Maeo 2021).
SS C (60 sec): cable crunch + hanging leg raise (core).
Finish: 5–10 min incline walk or stairs (easy, conversational pace).
Leg volume ramp: start week 1 with 2 sets of each leg move, 3 sets from week 2 on.

templates.name: Wed: Upper B — Volume / Stretch Work (~50 min)
templates.notes:
Superset blocks are linked in your log—alternate the two moves back-to-back, then take the listed rest after the SECOND move. Rest timers are set to that post-pair rest.
Heavy compounds: 2–3 min rest. Isolation pairs: 60–90 sec.
Effort: leave 1–2 reps in reserve (RIR) on compounds; last set of isolations can go to 0–1 RIR.
Progression: double progression—when every set hits the TOP of the rep range at ≤2 RIR, add 2.5–5 lb (cables/machines: one pin) next session and build back up. Target weights are starting points from your log—adjust to hit the range.
Warm-up: 1–2 ramp-up sets on the first lift only.

SS A (90 sec): flat DB press + seated DB rear delt fly.
SS B (75 sec): neutral-grip pulldown (vary your grip from Monday if you like) + lateral raise.
SS C (75 sec): incline DB fly (chest stretch, your pick over low-to-high) + single-arm DB row.
SS D (60 sec): rope pushdown + DB hammer curl. Swap pushdown for dips if shoulders feel good.
Goal: chest/back volume at moderate loads, rear delts, side delts, arms. Total ~24 sets.

templates.name: Thu: Complete Rest
templates.notes: Complete rest. No lifting. Hit your step goal, eat at target, protect sleep. This is the fixed rest day.

templates.name: Fri: Lower B — Hinge + Leg Press (~50 min)
templates.notes:
Superset blocks are linked in your log—alternate the two moves back-to-back, then take the listed rest after the SECOND move. Rest timers are set to that post-pair rest.
Heavy compounds: 2–3 min rest. Isolation pairs: 60–90 sec.

Progression: double progression—when every set hits the TOP of the rep range at ≤2 RIR, add 2.5–5 lb (cables/machines: one pin) next session and build back up. Target weights are starting points from your log—adjust to hit the range.
Warm-up: 1–2 ramp-up sets on the first lift only.

SS A (2 min after A2): DB RDL + DB shrug. Use lifting straps on both so grip never limits the set; RDL goes first.
SS B (2 min): leg press + leg-press/standing calf raise.
SS C (75 sec): leg extension + seated leg curl.
SS D (60 sec): weighted decline sit-up/crunch + hanging leg raise.
Finish (optional): 5–10 min stairs or incline walk.
Leg volume ramp: start week 1 with 2 sets per move, 3 sets from week 2.

templates.name: Sat: Day 5 — Face Pulls, Lats & Arms (~40 min)
templates.notes:
Superset blocks are linked in your log—alternate the two moves back-to-back, then take the listed rest after the SECOND move. Rest timers are set to that post-pair rest.
Heavy compounds: 2–3 min rest. Isolation pairs: 60–90 sec.

Progression: double progression—when every set hits the TOP of the rep range at ≤2 RIR, add 2.5–5 lb (cables/machines: one pin) next session and build back up. Target weights are starting points from your log—adjust to hit the range.
Warm-up: 1–2 ramp-up sets on the first lift only.

SS A (75 sec): face pull (rear delts/upper back—your must-have) + single-arm lat pulldown (lat width).
SS B (75 sec): lean-away cable lateral raise + overhead cable triceps extension.
SS C (60 sec): preacher curl + straight-arm pulldown.
SS D (60 sec): incline DB fly (upper chest) + hanging leg raise. Calves stay on Tuesday (standing) and Friday (leg press) so this day can hit upper chest instead.
Short and arm/delt/upper-chest by design: it fills weekly volume for weak points without wrecking recovery for Monday.

templates.name: Sun: Optional Day 6 — Weak-Point Pump (~35 min)
templates.notes:
Superset blocks are linked in your log—alternate the two moves back-to-back, then take the listed rest after the SECOND move. Rest timers are set to that post-pair rest.
Heavy compounds: 2–3 min rest. Isolation pairs: 60–90 sec.

Progression: double progression—when every set hits the TOP of the rep range at ≤2 RIR, add 2.5–5 lb (cables/machines: one pin) next session and build back up. Target weights are starting points from your log—adjust to hit the range.
Warm-up: 1–2 ramp-up sets on the first lift only.

OPTIONAL. Use it when you have time and energy; otherwise take Sunday as your flexible rest day (slide it to any day except Thu, keeping a rest day between the two lower sessions).
Targets the lagging areas: hamstrings, side delts, upper chest, lat width, and rear delts. Calves stay on Tuesday (standing) and Friday (leg press).
SS A (75 sec): seated leg curl + cable lateral raise.
SS B (75 sec): low-to-high cable fly + straight-arm pulldown.
SS C (60 sec): cable curl + rope pushdown (2 sets).
SS D (60 sec): rear delt cable fly + cable crunch (2 sets).
Keep it 1–3 reps from failure. Do not do this the day before Lower A if legs are still sore.

templates.name: School A: Delts & Arms Burner (~8 min)
templates.notes:
OPTIONAL — not part of the required week. Do it in a hallway, desk area, or study break. Equipment: 5, 8 and 20 lb dumbbells.
Light loads still build muscle when sets go close to failure: use a slow 3-sec lowering, 1-sec pause in the stretch, and stop with 1–2 reps in reserve.
Count these sets toward your weekly total—if you do School Delts/Arms, trim lateral/curl sets in the gym that day. Rest 30–45 sec between moves, ~60 sec between rounds.

SS A: 8 lb lateral raise + 5 lb bent-over rear delt fly, 3 rounds.
SS B: 20 lb curl + 20 lb overhead triceps extension, 3 rounds.
Optional: 20 lb hammer curl, 1 set to failure.

templates.name: School B: Legs & Calves Burner (~10 min)
templates.notes:

SS A: Bulgarian split squat (20s) with 2-sec pause at bottom + single-leg calf raise on a step.
SS B: single-leg DB RDL (20 lb) + glute bridge march or bodyweight squat to failure.
These keep legs frequent between Lower A and Lower B; they do not replace them.

templates.notes:

SS A: feet-elevated push-up to 1–2 reps short of failure + 20 lb one-arm DB row (hand on a desk/chair).
SS B: 20 lb DB floor press (pause on floor) + IYT raises (5 lb).

templates.notes:

Time-crunch version: 2 quick rounds, no equipment changes. Round = 8 lb lateral raise x 25, push-up x 15–20, 20 lb goblet squat x 15–20, dead bug x 10/side.

folders.name: Joey C4
folders.purpose: Joey C4: lean-bulk upper/lower hypertrophy for med school. Mon Upper A, Tue Lower A, Wed Upper B, Thu rest (fixed), Fri Lower B, Sat Day 5 (face pulls/lats/arms), Sun optional Day 6 weak-point pump or flexible rest. Built on ~10–15 weekly sets per muscle, each hit 2x/week, compounds at 6–12 reps with 2 min rest, isolations at 10–20 reps, 1–2 RIR, antagonist/non-competing supersets to save time. Four optional School Dumbbell routines (5/8/20 lb) are included for study breaks.
